name: EPIC 212004126
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 10.3 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,171 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.97 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,735 K at its surface.
